audit.why: HARD / 8/10 fits 43% over 393 games with Sett owning every row through first item.
audit.corrected: Left at HARD, 8/10. The win-rate figure quoted in prose was wrong and is corrected to 43%.

audit.whatIsWrong: whys[3], whys[4] and whys[5] are written for levels 4, 5 and 6, but those rows are Levels 4-5, Level 6 and First item.
audit.why: The Level 6 row is where The Show Stopper arrives; the First item row is where Sett's grit sustain still holds. Written as-is the page described level 6 in the first-item row.
audit.corrected: Rows realigned: 4-5 grit shield, 6 The Show Stopper, first item his sustain.

audit.whatIsWrong: Facebreaker (E) is described as a stun that grabs you in lane, and The Show Stopper is called a point-and-click suppress. Both are wrong, and the ult's real anti-Yi property is never stated.
audit.why: Riot's text: Facebreaker pulls in enemies on OPPOSITE sides of Sett and stuns them — if they were only on one side they are slowed instead. In a 1v1 you are slowed, not stunned. The Show Stopper carries and slams; its grounding denies Alpha Strike, which is the actual reason your escape disappears (missingInteractions: dash-denied). Facebreaker and R also cancel Meditate's channel. Haymaker deals TRUE damage in the centre and physical on the sides, so positioning off-centre matters.
audit.corrected: E: 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s, stuns only with enemies flanking him, otherwise a slow. R: 120/100/80s, grounds Alpha Strike. W: grit-scaled shield, true damage centre only. Never Meditate with his E up.

audit.why: The packet figure is 43% over 393 games.

edits.before: At level 3 his Facebreaker (E) stun sets up combos you can't answer.
edits.after: At level 3 Facebreaker (E) drags you into a Haymaker (W) hit.

edits.before: Through level 4 his HP and shielded true damage still out-trade you.
edits.after: At 4-5 his grit shield and true damage still out-trade you hard.

edits.before: At level 5 his CC and burst keep kill pressure firmly his.
edits.after: At 6 The Show Stopper (R) grounds you and slams you down.

edits.before: At level 6 his Show Stopper (R) suppress can flat kill you.
edits.after: First item still loses: grit sustain wins extended fights.

edits.before: Sett crushes this window: his Haymaker (W) shields then deals huge true damage, his fists (Q passive) out-trade you, and Facebreaker (E) grabs and stuns you in place - your Alpha Strike (Q) can't out-value his shielded burst.
edits.after: Sett crushes this window: Haymaker (W) turns the grit he banked off your poke into a shield plus true damage down its centre, and Facebreaker (E) only stuns with enemies on both sides of him - alone you are slowed, so stand off-centre and walk.

edits.before: His Show Stopper (R) suppresses and slams you, a hard all-in that flat kills you if you're in range; with Highlander (R) you can try to sprint out, but 6 is still heavily Sett's.
edits.after: The Show Stopper (R) carries and slams you on 120s at rank 1, and its grounding shuts off Alpha Strike, so your one escape is gone the moment he picks you up - level 6 is heavily Sett's.

edits.before: Sett owns levels 1-3 hard: his passive fists out-trade your autos, Haymaker (W) shields him then deals true damage, and Facebreaker (E) stuns you into his combo. There is no early trade you win - just farm, stay out of E range, and don't die to his all-in.
edits.after: Sett owns levels 1-3 hard: his passive fists out-trade your autos, Haymaker (W) shields him then deals true damage, and Facebreaker (E) slows you when you are the only target on one side. There is no early trade you win - farm outside his 490 range.

edits.before: Levels 4-6 stay Sett's. His Haymaker (W) burst scales with the fight, Facebreaker (E) locks you down, and his level 6 Show Stopper (R) is a point-blank suppress that flat kills you. Respect his CC cooldowns and refuse every fight where he has E and R available.
edits.after: Levels 4-6 stay Sett's. Haymaker (W) scales with the grit he banks off your poke, Facebreaker (E) is 16s falling to 10s, and The Show Stopper (R) grounds Alpha Strike so you cannot blink out of the slam. Refuse every fight where his E and R are both up.

edits.before: Bait Facebreaker (E) stun and Show Stopper (R) before committing
edits.after: Bait Facebreaker (E) and The Show Stopper (R) before committing

edits.before: Use Show Stopper (R) to suppress and delete you before you scale
edits.after: Use The Show Stopper (R) to ground you and delete you early

edits.before: His level-6 R suppress + W true-damage all-in flat-out kills you, and Meditate cannot out-heal a suppression burst combo while you're locked.
edits.after: His level-6 R carries you off and grounds Alpha Strike, so the W true-damage smash lands with no blink out and Meditate cannot cover the burst.

edits.before: Track his E (grab/stun) above all — it's his only hard lockdown and the answer to your Alpha Strike untargetability; if it's down you can trade and disengage far more freely. Secondarily respect his W when he's banked a lot of your poke into it.
edits.after: Track Facebreaker (E) above all — 16s at rank 1 down to 10s, and note it only stuns with enemies on both sides of him, so solo you are just slowed. With it down you trade and disengage freely. Respect Haymaker once he has banked your poke into grit.

edits.before: It's 8/10 because Sett beats you at literally every lane stage from 1 through 6 — grit trades, true-damage W, and a point-and-click R suppress that hard-counters your only escape (Alpha Strike) — and you're a weak early laner who can't punish back until two items deep. The 38.73% win rate is real; you are surviving, not winning lane.
edits.after: It's 8/10 because Sett beats you at literally every lane stage from 1 through 6 — grit trades, a true-damage W, and an R that grounds Alpha Strike and so hard-counters your only escape — and you're a weak early laner who can't punish back until two items deep. The 43% win rate is real; you are surviving lane, not winning it.

edits.before: Alpha Strike's untargetability can dodge his E grab and R suppress cast if timed, but the moment Q ends you're targetable — and his W true damage and R suppress both bypass Meditate (suppression cancels the channel entirely).
edits.after: Alpha Strike's untargetability can dodge his E and R cast if timed, but the moment Q ends you're targetable — and his R grounds you, so the blink is simply unavailable, while Facebreaker cancels a Meditate channel outright on its 10-16s.

edits.before: Meditate's damage reduction does nothing while you're suppressed by his R, and W's true damage ignores your sustain — do not channel into his ult combo.
edits.after: Facebreaker cancels the Meditate channel outright, and Haymaker's centre true damage erases whatever you did heal — never channel while his E is off cooldown.

edits.before: HARD — 8/10 difficulty, ~38.7% win rate; Sett beats you every lane stage 1-6, so survive, scale to 2 items, and carry from teamfights, not from lane.
edits.after: HARD — 8/10 difficulty, 43% win rate; Sett beats you every lane stage 1-6, so survive, scale to two on-hit items, and carry from fights, not from lane.

notes: All three packet suspectNames are genuine: the correct Riot name is 'The Show Stopper', not 'Show Stopper'. Two bigger corrections: Facebreaker only STUNS when enemies are on opposite sides of Sett — in a 1v1 top lane you are slowed, and the page claimed a stun in five places. And the ult's anti-Yi property is grounding (Alpha Strike denied), not suppression; I wrote grounding rather than assert a suppression flag Riot's text does not state. Level chart matches the packet, no chart edits.
